g.text: PF-C. Event detection: GALE-CAST Model-W1+X1 versus event persistence and event climatology
Evidence A (website scorecard) and Evidence B (training-consistent benchmark), each on its own identical cases; overall evidence
Model: deployed GALE-CAST Model-W1 (SHA-256 f2db5aa9…9d14b0), historical scoring procedure (_w1_recall_floor.py: pooled scaled_weather inputs, 32-day
windows); X1 = same-date mean of the three stations' scores; warning if X1 ≥ 0.601 (threshold unchanged). Panel B: per-station scalers as in training
Baselines: event persistence = label of the issue day; event climatology = station × month label frequency, 2015-01-02 to 2020-10-14, warning if ≥
0.0355 (chosen on 2020-10-15 to 2021-10-14 only). Panel B's event climatology threshold, chosen the same way on raw labels: 0.0355.
Intervals: paired circular block bootstrap over target dates, 14-day blocks, 2,000 resamples, 95% percentile.
Cohorts differ (cases, input scaling, label truth: processed in A, raw unimputed in B); compare methods within a panel, not across panels.
